filter_scope_surface_label: Example filter/facet posture for an official voter-information result set
delivery_role_note: Bounded filter/facet surface for official voter-information routes where subset controls decide which answer-bearing items are currently visible.
default_scope_note: The route states whether the initial view is the full official set or a default-narrowed subset and names any default filters that are already active.
active_subset_visibility_note: After filters change, the route keeps the active scope visible in the results area and in compact/mobile variants rather than hiding it inside a closed drawer.
selection_model_note: Each group makes clear whether one choice or multiple choices are allowed.
selection_state_exposure_note: Selected choices remain visibly and programmatically exposed so a voter can tell which subset currently controls the visible answers.
results_changed_announcement_note: A bounded status message announces meaningful result-set changes, including narrowed scope, zero-results states, and recovery after clearing filters.
compact_mobile_filter_visibility_note: Compact/mobile variants preserve the active-scope summary and the clear/reset path after the filter tray closes.
clear_reset_note: The route keeps an ordinary clear/reset path that returns the user from a narrowed or empty subset to the broader official set.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Where filters alone may not resolve the case, a visible overview/help lane remains available instead of forcing trial-and-error facet changes.
